definitions: A genre of filmmaking, especially horror, in which all or a substantial part of the film is presented as if it were discovered film or video recordings.
The actual film or video recordings that are presented as if they were discovered, often used within the 'found footage' genre.
examples: The Blair Witch Project popularized found footage.
Many horror movies utilize found footage.
The police discovered the found footage.
She analyzed the found footage for clues.
